Ms V K Aggarwal
--Petitioner
 Versus

Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Shrikant Purohit, learned counsel 
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned Standing 
counsel along with Mr. Hargovind Pant, 
learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Present contempt petition has been 
filed alleging wilful disobedience and non￾compliance of the order dated 01.04.2025 
passed by this Court in Writ Petition (S/S) 
No. 844 of 2025, titled M/s V.K. Aggarwal 
and another Vs. State of Uttarakhand and 
Others.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that, on an earlier occasion, this 
Court had called for instructions from the 
learned State Counsel with regard to 
compliance of the aforesaid order.
5. On the basis of the instructions so 
received, learned State Counsel would 
submit that a part of the amount due and 
payable to the petitioner has already been 
released. However, according to him, certain  dues could not be disbursed for want of 
requisite documents, which are stated to be 
required to be furnished by the petitioner 
before the concerned Department. It is, 
however, fairly admitted by learned State 
Counsel that, as on date, the entire amount 
found due and payable to the petitioner 
pursuant to the order dated 01.04.2025 has 
not yet been paid.
6. In view of the aforesaid submission and 
the admitted position regarding non￾compliance of the order of this Court, let 
notices be issued to the respondents, 
returnable at an early date.
7. Steps for service of notice upon the 
respondents shall be taken by the petitioner 
within one week.
8. The respondents shall file their 
respective affidavits/compliance affidavits, 
specifically indicating the steps taken for 
due and complete compliance of the order 
dated 01.04.2025, within a period of three 
weeks from the date of service of notice.
9. List this case on 17.09.2026.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
 14-08-2026
Mamta
